title: AAPS 3.3.0-dev Report insulin without injection not captured
body:
I reported about insulin that I gave in a syringe so that it would take into account and stop the basal, and it was not absorbed and was not taken into account, I went back to 3.2.0.3 and it was absorbed, I went back to 3.3.0 and again it was not absorbed so this is a problem in this version
Attach logs it happened for the first time at 11:54 (maybe a minute before or after)
And a second time at 12:09
Thanks for all the improvements and hard work
